workflow-1774810457347-0nw438.name: frodo-feature-dev
workflow-1774810457347-0nw438.description: Full-stack feature development workflow for Frodo. Plans, implements with TDD, reviews, and prepares for merge.

config.description: Analyze requirements, identify affected modules (backend/modules/, frontend/src/app/, workers/), map dependencies, create implementation plan with phases
Write failing tests for the feature using pytest markers (unit/integration). Follow RED phase of TDD. Target 80%+ coverage for new code.

tasks.name: implement-backend
tasks.description: Implement backend: routes/ + services/ + schemas.py pattern. Follow PEP 8, type annotations, ruff format.

tasks.name: implement-frontend
tasks.description: Implement frontend: Next.js App Router pages, Tailwind via cn(), components in components/ui/. Update api.ts client if needed.

config.description: Run full test suite. All tests must pass (GREEN phase). Fix any failures.

tasks.name: lint-format
tasks.command: ruff format backend/ tests/ && ruff check backend/ tests/ --fix

config.description: Review all changed files. Check for OWASP top 10, proper error handling, tenant isolation (workspace_id), and convention compliance.

if_true.description: Deep security review: JWT handling, RBAC enforcement, token vault operations, SQL injection, XSS prevention

workflow-1774810468995-7uq44z.name: frodo-tiktok-api-integration
workflow-1774810468995-7uq44z.description: Workflow for integrating real TikTok API endpoints. Validates auth, tests with sandbox, handles rate limits and error responses.

config.description: Research the specific TikTok API endpoint from knowledge-base/ (60 files). Identify auth requirements, rate limits, request/response schemas, error codes, and sandbox vs production differences.
Check the platform client in backend/tiktok/ (shop/, developer/, marketing/, live/, research/). Verify the method signature matches real API docs. Update if needed.
Verify gateway.py routing, rate_limiter.py token bucket config, circuit_breaker.py thresholds, and retry.py backoff for this platform. Tune for real API behavior.
Write integration tests with @pytest.mark.integration that test against real API sandbox. Mock only external network, not internal logic. Test error responses and rate limit handling.
Verify token acquisition, refresh, and vault storage for this platform. Check AES-256-GCM encryption, Celery Beat refresh schedule, and error recovery.
Update the corresponding sync worker in backend/workers/ to handle real API responses, pagination, error codes, and retry logic.

workflow-1774810478733-jgyhr6.name: frodo-module-creation
workflow-1774810478733-jgyhr6.description: Scaffold and implement a new backend module following Frodo's standard pattern.

config.description: Design module: define routes, services, schemas, DB models, and any cross-module bridges. Identify which TikTok platforms this module interacts with.
Create module directory: backend/modules/<name>/__init__.py, routes/__init__.py, services/__init__.py, schemas.py. Add DB models to backend/db/models/. Register routes in backend/main.py.

tasks.name: write-schemas
tasks.description: Pydantic v2 request/response models in schemas.py

tasks.name: write-services
tasks.description: Business logic in services/, using dependency injection

tasks.name: write-routes
tasks.description: FastAPI routers with proper auth deps (CurrentUser, get_workspace_id)

tasks.name: write-tests
tasks.description: pytest unit tests with fixtures from conftest.py

if_true.description: Create sync worker in backend/workers/, add beat schedule to celery_app.py

workflow-1774810489885-juy4ap.name: frodo-production-hardening
workflow-1774810489885-juy4ap.description: Systematic production readiness workflow. Addresses the 79 items needed for production deployment.

config.description: Run full audit: test coverage, security scan (bandit), type checking (mypy), dependency audit. Map current status of 79 production readiness items.

tasks.name: auth-audit
tasks.description: JWT validation, RBAC enforcement, session management, CORS config

tasks.name: input-validation
tasks.description: All API endpoints validate input via Pydantic, SQL parameterized queries

tasks.name: secrets-audit
tasks.description: No hardcoded secrets, proper env var usage via config.py

tasks.name: dependency-audit
tasks.description: Check for vulnerable dependencies, pin versions

tasks.name: db-optimization
tasks.description: Connection pooling, query optimization, index review for 120 models

tasks.name: cache-strategy
tasks.description: Redis caching for hot paths, token cache TTLs, rate limit tuning

tasks.name: api-performance
tasks.description: Response time profiling, N+1 query detection, pagination enforcement

config.description: Add structured logging, health check endpoints, metrics collection, error tracking integration points

tasks.name: docker-optimization
tasks.description: Multi-stage builds, health checks, resource limits in docker-compose

tasks.name: env-config
tasks.description: Separate dev/staging/prod configs, secrets management

tasks.name: ci-cd
tasks.description: GitHub Actions pipeline: lint -> test -> build -> deploy

workflow-1774810497532-88t6xf.name: frodo-testing-blitz
workflow-1774810497532-88t6xf.description: Comprehensive testing workflow to improve coverage and catch regressions across the entire Frodo codebase.

config.description: Run coverage analysis to identify uncovered modules and functions
Analyze coverage report. Identify: modules below 80%, untested edge cases, missing integration tests, untested error paths in TikTok clients

tasks.name: unit-tests
tasks.description: Write unit tests for uncovered functions. Use fixtures from conftest.py. Mark with @pytest.mark.unit

tasks.name: integration-tests
tasks.description: Write integration tests for API endpoints and DB operations. Mark with @pytest.mark.integration

tasks.name: edge-case-tests
tasks.description: Write tests for error paths: invalid tokens, rate limits, circuit breaker trips, malformed API responses

config.description: Run full suite, verify all tests pass including new ones
Verify coverage meets 80%+ target across all modules
